date.add_months_clamped.domain: years 0001..9999; out of range is E_DATE_RANGE
date.add_months_clamped.inputs: Gregorian date and integer month count
date.add_months_clamped.result: shift the month and clamp the day to the destination month end

date.month_end.result: last date of the same month

list.length.domain: accepted observed lists within resource limits

list.sequence.domain: at most 10000 elements; excess is E_RESOURCE_LIMIT
list.sequence.result: begin inclusive to end exclusive, empty when end <= begin

numeric.min.domain: all values in the declared type
